facts.text: Bachelor's degree programs are delivered on an accelerated schedule, allowing students to complete their degree in as few as 20 months on campus or 27 months online.

sources.title: Virtual Information Sessions - Undergraduate - Full Sail University
sources.quote: In these sessions, you'll learn how Full Sail University delivers our bachelor's degree curriculum in an accelerated format, as few as 20 months on campus and 27 months online.
